comment: What the quests stage in the world (ULyudQuestDirector, docs/quests.md). pickups: an item lying out while its quest is on one of the stages; ux, uy, floor_uz are Unreal metres as in PeopleData/people_places.json (the floor under it; it drops from drop_m above onto whatever stands there), yaw the way its top points. listeners: people who notice a bird calling beside them; the first reaction that fits is said (species, quest + stage, air = called on the wing near by); the quests get bird_call <Species>.<Body> when the bird sat within within_m. remarks: a person says the lines of their own accord, once, when the hero walks within within_m while the quest is on one of the stages. One person answers a call: whoever a quest in progress waits to hear from, else the nearest.

pickups.note: the issue desk's reader's ledge (top 1.05 m over the floor), between the returned books and the card tray, its top towards the librarian: blender/academgorodok/library.py issue_desk() at ISSUE_DESK through people_map.py's house frame (her chair: -240.21, 628.99, facing 169); a visitor stands at about -241.8, 629.25

listeners.note: 22 m, not Sorokin's 14: at her iMac (club seat 7) she is 20.3 m down the hall from the club's door, so a sparrow that only reaches the doorstep still counts; outdoors any perch near her does

Bench academ_bench_2 on the Academgorodok's square, yard_evening 17:00-18:30 every day (her lectures are work_away 9-14 on weekdays). Aya sketches on the same bench 16:30-19:00, so a call there can make both answer. 5 m / 12 m, not 14 / 45: the square's six benches are 6.7-17.6 m apart and Sorokin's 14 m already covers most of it.

Bench academ_bench_1 on the square, yard_evening 16:00-17:15 every day (school 8:15-13 on weekdays). The bench where the crow took her button. HoodedCrow is the crow of the quest (grey, 'not grey' in the CarrionCrow line); carrion crows roost with the hooded crows (bird_life.md).

Mending nets on the promenade bench S-BENCH-P12 (map 100.8, 867.9), mend_nets 12:30-17:00 every day, nobody else's duty near; at sea 4:30-11 he is hidden (work_sea, away) and hears nothing. Gulls rest on the beach and roofs and feed in the streets, cormorants dive off the beach (bird_life.md). The catch-stage line sends the gull to the pier, where first_catch's hero is meant to be.

Bench academ_bench_5 on the square, yard_evening 17:00-18:30 every day (the Laboratory 8-16:30 on weekdays, away). Rustam shares the bench from 18:00. The done line rests on round 2's 'key on a string round my neck'.

Bench academ_bench_2 on the square, sketch_yard 16:30-19:00 every day, with a pencil (shares the bench with Dasha 17-18:30); mornings she paints on the island (paint_island, off by train). Starlings: the murmuration over the sea at dusk is one of her three views; they are away in December and January, so that reaction simply does not fire then. The gull line answers her round 1 aside (the island gull that never landed).

Bench academ_bench_0 on the square, yard_evening 17:30-19:00 every day (the Laboratory 9-16 on weekdays). She says 'вы' even to a bird, as to the hero. The quest reaction has no species and stands after the blue tit: during soda_science's taste stage it answers every other sitting bird, so the generic line waits until the quest moves on.

Bench academ_bench_1 on the square, yard_evening 17:30-19:00 every day (the Laboratory 9-17 on weekdays), after Yuki leaves it at 17:15. The rook line rests on round 2's letter to the editors (overdue_journal done). Rooks feed in streets and rest on roofs and wires.

Bench academ_bench_0 on the square, yard_evening 14:00-16:30 every day; Ivan is on academ_bench_3 (12.4 m away) from 15:00. evening_paper's 'buy' stage is the one while the hero is off to the fair square for the paper.

Bench academ_bench_3 on the square, yard_evening 15:00-17:30 every day; in free time often fish_shore (the beach, the pier, the island: likes 0.6), where a heron stalking the waterline is a likely neighbour. He did not know the cob was coming (hot_corn), so his corn line is only after done.

Bench academ_bench_5 on the square, yard_evening 18:00-19:30 every day (the Laboratory 8:30-17:30 on weekdays): dusk in autumn, the hour night_signal's 'signal' stage waits for. The air reaction for the signal stage stands before his plain air one.

At her corn cart (corn_stall, the square), work_corn 11:00-18:00 every day, standing outdoors by the pot. The cart is 4.6 m from Sorokin's bench (academ_bench_4), inside his 14 m: during his hours both may answer the same call. The done line follows round 2's 'Vanya oiled my wheel, it's gone quiet'.

At his cheese tent on the club's forecourt (cheese_tent, 3.5 m from the club door), work_cheese 10:00-20:00, Tuesday to Sunday. The club door's sparrows are Sonya's (Kuzya, sparrow_hello done, round 2); Sonya's own 22 m may catch the same call when she is outside. The taste-stage air line: the hero is meant to be down at the diner by the lower cable car station for the pancakes.

remarks.note: the hero walks into the Gastronom (Tanya behind the counter, Mon-Sat 9-19) while he still gathers the guide, rowan and feeder; said before he talks to her, so it leads into her own 'Сушёная рябина? Её один Сорокин и брал.'
the guide taken, the hero passes Olya (library desk 10-15 Wed-Sat, or anywhere in the Academgorodok) on his way north
the hero crouches by his peanut feeder in the Academgorodok's yard; Dasha's yard_evening is on academ_bench_2, 17-18:30, and she walks the yard after lectures
after Aya (his friend in people.json) heard the hero's report; Sorokin on his bench (academ_bench_4, 8-12:30, 14:30-18:30) calls it out when the hero passes. Echoes Aya's 'Маленький и тихий'
the hero crosses the yard with the cob; Nina sits on academ_bench_0 14-16:30, Ivan on academ_bench_3 15-17:30 (both yard_evening), otherwise he fishes off the beach
hooded crows live in pairs on the beach (docs/corvids.md); Lange is about the beach and the promenade (mend_nets 12:30-17, fish_shore), so the hero feeding crows there passes him
Yuki sits on academ_bench_1 16-17:15 (yard_evening), the bench the crow took her button from; she watches the hero feed crows from a safe distance
Misha is Rustam's friend and shares academ_bench_5 with him in the evening (Misha 17-18:30); the hero passes through the yard on the way to the lamp or the station
Vika is the other side of Dasha's bet (her flatmate); she is in the yard on academ_bench_3 18-19:30 and after work
Lev on academ_bench_1 17:30-19 or in the yard after the Laboratory; sets up Galina's tell line 'Лев уверяет, что различит их с закрытыми глазами'
after Lev paid for the new issue; Galina on academ_bench_0 17:30-19 in the yard
the hero comes to her corn cart (work_corn 11-18 every day) on Aslan's errand; they are friends in people.json
Nao keeps the club's door 10-21 every day, a few metres from Aslan's tent where the owner sent the hero for the braid
the hero comes up to Aslan's cheese tent by the club door (work_cheese 10-20, not Monday) for Lange's braid; Lange's own line: 'Утром рыба, вечером рыба'

inside the club hall: Yamada sits at station 9 (work_clerk 10-19, Monday to Friday, his own_slot); the hero crosses the hall to the soda machine for Galina's four samples. Indoors, people are drawn within 40 m, so he is there to speak.

the booth in the club (work_booth 12:00-02:00 every day): Ogawa sells the head lamp over his counter (BoothOwner.cpp goods: bird_feed, head_lamp), which Rustam sent the hero for. Echoes his everyday 'Свет не трогай. Он сам знает, когда гореть.'
inside the club: Timur at his station 0 after the warehouse (work_away 7:30-15 on weekdays, free after); a friend of the owner in people.json. Echoes his own 'Вентиляция гудит в ля-миноре'.
inside the club: Vera, Sonya's mother (household vera), at her Spectrum on station 4 after the Laboratory (work_lab 9-15 on weekdays); Sonya sits at station 7 in the same hall.
inside the club: Tyoma at station 6, next to Sonya's 7, after school (8:15-13:30 on weekdays) until bed at 21:30; Sonya is his friend in people.json.

the library: Olya at the issue desk (work_library 10-15, Wednesday to Saturday); Aya is her friend in people.json. Also works if she says it in the club in the evening (station 8): 'заходила' is to the library either way.

inside the Gastronom: Tanya behind the counter (work_shop 9-19, Monday to Saturday). Follows her round-1 'Её один Сорокин и брал'; dried rowan is on her counter (counters.json feed_rowan). Sorokin only hopes: the waxwings stay in the grove.
the club's doorstep and forecourt (watch_door 10-21 every day), a few metres from Aslan's tent; the hero comes in and out of the club past her.

the yard: Lev on academ_bench_1 17:30-19 (yard_evening). Pays off his round-1 remark ('Байкал от Тархуна я отличу с закрытыми глазами') and Galina's 'Теперь проверим Льва'; he claimed only Baikal against Tarragon, so the mix-up is in the other pair.

the yard after the Laboratory (work_lab 10-18 on weekdays; no fixed bench, free in the evening). Kei is the one who called the soup the best in town (Vika's lunch_ask.2); echoes his own 'Свет у моря другой. Я меряю его каждый день'.
the yard: Misha on academ_bench_5 17-18:30, the bench he shares with Rustam (friends). Agrees with Rustam's own after-talk about a brighter lamp being another experiment.
the yard: Vika on academ_bench_3 18-19:30; she lost Dasha's bet (a week of dishes). Follows her round-1 'Голубь тоже птица'.
Sorokin on academ_bench_4 (8-12:30, 14:30-18:30) calls it out as the hero crosses the square; magpies do recognise individual human faces.

at the corn cart on the Academgorodok's square (work_corn 11-18 every day); Aslan is her friend. Pays off her round-1 'он мою кукурузу хвалит, а сам ни разу не пробовал' and Aslan's tell 'Валентина соли не жалеет'.
Ivan on academ_bench_3 15-17:30 or fishing off the beach in the morning; Lange is his friend in people.json. 'Двадцать лет' is Lange's own 'Двадцать лет рыба'.
the yard: Nina on academ_bench_0 14-16:30, Yuki on academ_bench_1 16-17:15 (they overlap 16-16:30). Echoes Tanya's 'Нина сегодня уже третий раз. Поговорить.'
